title: Positivity of the query count
statement: Let $n$ be a positive natural number and let $C$ be a Boolean circuit on $n$ input bits. The query count in the four-query PCPP description assigned to $C$ by the semantic reduction is positive.
hypotheses_covered: $C$ is a Boolean circuit on $n$ input bits
replaced:
Let $n$ be a positive natural number and let $C$ be a Boolean circuit on $n$ input bits.
The semantic PCPP reduction assigning to $C$ its four-query PCPP description has
positive query count.
